rows.name: cell_height
rows.description: Final cell height = volume / basal_area; the confinement readout (higher = more confined/taller).

rows.name: confinement
rows.description: Cell height relative to the initial height (volume/area0); the Fig 1G regime variable.

rows.name: bm_stress
rows.description: BM reaction stress = bm_stiffness * (basal_area - BM rest area); the mechanistic driver of confinement.

rows.name: basal_area
rows.description: Current basal area of the prism cell (grows under proliferation, resisted by the BM).
